workItems.title: Deliver CommonTesting-based CountryData unit examples and testing guidance
workItems.acceptanceCriteria: Readable discoverable unit examples against the actual compiled app cover publication/aliases/no lookup I/O, manual refresh replacement/failure, initial failure, original fault and owned cleanup, plus direct lookup-step semantics. Reuse public CommonTesting, add expected-result and integration-boundary guidance, preserve production and user files.
workItems.validation: Focused native Unit build/restore and CountryData unit filter; scoped ordinary formatter+verify; strict documentation checks and independent source review. Keep examples host/network-free and public-only, with held operations released/joined. Confirm dependency lock changes reflect only the approved existing app closure and no production reference to CommonTesting.

workItems.title: Place CountryData unit examples in a dedicated examples solution project
workItems.acceptanceCriteria: Same23public CommonTesting examples live in dedicated CountryData.UnitTests under examples physically and in CisLib.slnx; old shared suite loses the example reference/closure; guide paths and run command updated.
workItems.validation: Build/discover/run the new MSTest project on pinned runtime; verify all23pass and solution membership, public-only assembly boundary, no duplicate test source or Core-suite app reference, locked approved dependency closure, scoped format and docs; preserve user files and unchanged aggregate resource limits.
